response.courseDescription: 483 Micro and Molecular Biology of Wine Laboratory Identification of microorganisms (non-spoilage and spoilage) using microscopic, molecular, and selective media methods; evaluation of factors related to the survival of yeast and bacteria in wine; strategies for restarting stuck yeast and malolactic fermentations. Credit not granted for both VIT ENOL 483 and 583.
